seed.home.heroTitle: A page of blocks, in one editor
seed.home.heroLead: Layout and text are one tree of blocks. Click text to type, click its edge to choose the block.
seed.home.areaText: Click any text and type. Click beside the text or on a block’s edge to choose the block: its parameters are on the right. Esc goes a level up, Enter goes in.
seed.home.li1: Point between blocks: a + offers what fits that place.
seed.home.li2: Drag a block from the library on the left, or click it: it lands after the chosen one.
seed.home.li3: Type “/” in an empty line for the catalogue.
seed.home.alert: Undo is one history: Cmd+Z undoes typed text and a moved section alike.
seed.home.columnsText: A column holds anything but a section. The number of columns is set for the desktop, the tablet and the phone apart.
